about: flagship/voucher-link/v1 (packages/protocol/src/voucherLink.ts, docs/anonymous-vouchers.md "Voucher links"). `vouchers` are 35 test vouchers under `key` (test-vectors/vouchers/test-rsa-key.json). `links.single` is encodeVoucherLinks(vouchers[0..3)), `links.chunked` encodeVoucherLinks(all 35) (30 + 5). `parse` cases: expect.ok with part, parts, keyId, count and each voucher's nullifier, or expect.code. `imports`: wallet.vouchers / spent are indexes into `vouchers` (spent as nullifiers), plus `filler` placeholder vouchers {k: "ffffffffffffffff", p: 64 zeros, n: i as 64-hex, s: "AAAA"} for i in 0..filler; link entries are indexes, "forged" (`forged`) or "otherKey" (`otherKey`); keys "test" = [key], "none" = []; expect.add lists indexes.

parse.name: a trailing slash on the path
